host_findings: The template's '-p 741641:741641/udp' became 54879/udp mapped 54879->54879 (identity). Read the real port from the instance's ports map.
tailscaled in the image already listens on that identity port (/etc/default/tailscaled PORT); stop/disable it before WireGuard uses the port.
The image has no apt lists: run apt-get update before installing wireguard-tools.
Sunshine 2025.924 is installed but not running; the desktop session is 'user' on DISPLAY=:0 via SDDM (no kiosk applied in this test).
Vast requires an SSH key on the account (not just the instance) to create VM instances; creating with the raw image (no template_hash_id) failed with 'no_such_ask'.
